site_decisions: Added pale yellow AgI precipitation tube because chem-m8-l03.md names it and the existing m5x set has no AgI plate.
Strontium flame and sediment core were explicitly requested in brief 60 but not found in Chemistry Module 8 site HTML. They are optional until a lesson uses them.
The current site uses river water and treatment examples. The single capped bottle v2 is preferred over the dipper composite v1.

The organic test tubes follow chem-m8-l11.md and brief 60. The permanganate clear state represents the acidified colourless result; a brown precipitate can occur under other conditions described on the site.

The brief 57 qualitative-ion pre-design pack identified two further gaps in the precipitation set: cream AgBr and green Fe(OH)2. Both were added as imagegen edits of the AgI tube to match its rack and scale.

site_decisions: Cataract eye pair and lens-clouding clip omitted. Cataracts are absent from the Module 8 site lessons. Lesson 19 teaches refractive errors, glasses, contacts and LASIK.
The requested glucose meter process pair uses the continuous glucose monitor reader named in lessons 03 and 14. Its screen has only a coloured bar, with aligned low and high states.
World map, hospital bed and insulin pen are explicit brief objects, but those exact phrases are absent from the Module 8 site lessons. Treat them as optional context plates.
Skin pair shows an ordinary mole and a melanoma because melanoma and UV prevention appear in lessons 06, 08 and 16.
A standalone sun disc and a blank CGM reader were added after final scope check. The blank reader shares framing with the low and high bar states.
discarded_retakes: Earlier pancreas, eye, ear, cochlear implant and lung outputs had opaque painted vignettes. Clean retakes replaced them.
m8-lungs-healthy-smoker-v1.png and m8-melanoma-pair-v1.png were discarded from public assets after separate aligned states were made.

review_notes: Cataract and lens-clouding plates were omitted because no Module 8 Biology site lesson uses cataracts.
The glucose process states use the site continuous glucose monitor reader.
AgBr cream, AgI pale yellow and Fe(OH)2 green precipitation tubes were added from the brief 57 Module 8 ion-test pack.
The world map has unlabelled, watercolour-filled continents for legibility at 200 px.
Generated line differences in the reagent process pairs call for cuts or short dissolves.
